License: blst/LICENSE (Apache-2.0)
The extracted upstream source is unmodified. The baseline-local official build.sh creates libblst.a.
Uses: canonical BLS12-381 G1 wire validation and mathematically equivalent native random-scalar SRS generation.
No hash-to-curve or proof primitive replacement is introduced. Native relation, transcript, Hyrax and Sumcheck are unchanged by this dependency.
Trusted setup assumes an honest local generating process that reliably erases independent OS-CSPRNG scalars. Scalars are never persisted; the setup helper clears its scalar buffers with OPENSSL_cleanse including exceptional exits. This is not a transparent setup or an authenticated external ceremony.
